HYDE WALK RESIDENCE BY IMTIAZ

Description:

Experience modern urban living in Hyde Walk Residence, a contemporary development located in Al Satwa within the Jumeirah Garden City master community. Designed with stylish interiors and high-quality finishes, this residence offers a fully furnished lifestyle with seamless access to major landmarks, retail, dining, and transport links. Its prime location ensures convenience, comfort, and a vibrant city-living experience.

Features:

Fully furnished modern interiors
High-quality finishes and well-designed layouts
Prime central location near Sheikh Zayed Road
Easy access to Downtown, DIFC, La Mer, and major attractions
Integrated retail and lifestyle convenience
Scenic city views depending on the unit

Amenities:

Rooftop swimming pool
Fully equipped gym
Sauna and steam room
Club lounge / social areas
Kids play area
BBQ and outdoor seating spaces
On-site retail outlets
EV charging stations
Covered parking + visitor parking
24/7 security and CCTV
